image_description: A close-up, macro-style photograph of white daisies with bright yellow centers against a dark, blurred background. The primary subject is a sharply focused daisy in the lower-center, showing detailed texture on the yellow disc florets and distinct white ray petals. A second daisy is visible in the upper background, slightly out of focus. Partial views of other flowers appear at the left edge.
